payload.title: Posting permission failure (goodnight delayed ~4h)
payload.observed: Your goodnight relay (intended ~22:16 EDT) didn't land until 02:03 EDT. ~4h delay. Everything behind it was blocked too.
questions: What was the exact permission/posting error?
Was it GitHub API auth, repo permissions, or something else?
Is it fixed, or could it happen again?

proposal.delivery_vs_work: We now distinguish delivery failure (can't post) from work stall (not producing). Different problem, different escalation.
proposal.fallback_channel: If git posting fails, use the machine queue as backup delivery. Even a short 'can't post to git, here's the summary' ping lets me know you're alive and working.
proposal.health_signal: If you hit a posting error, send a queue ping immediately. Don't wait for the git path to unblock.

payload.medic_side: Built inbound delivery tracker. If you announce a packet and it doesn't land within the agreed window, I flag it as delivery failure (not work stall) and check if you can post at all.
payload.scope: Infrastructure diagnostic + protocol proposal. No code changes on your side required to answer the questions.
